{{Quote|You've been working on that thing for years... |Amee to nine-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] about his [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Amee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the slave quarters of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was six years old around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. She wore [[Unidentified teeth implement|braces]].

==Biography==
[[File:Amee_and_Anakin.png|thumb|left|220px|Amee and Anakin Skywalker]]
Amee was born into a slave family owned by [[Yor Millto]], though her mother [[Hala]] was lost to the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Krayn]] when Amee was four. Amee continued to live on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with her father. She worked as a house slave for a rich [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] couple in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] from a very young age. Her employers gave her one afternoon off each month.<ref name="Jedi Quest: Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref> On the eve of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]], Amee visited Anakin and his friends in his backyard, where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|young Skywalker]] was testing his [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] ahead of the contest. Amee mocked Anakin's efforts, and left to play ball with [[Seek/Legends|Seek]] and [[Melee/Legends|Melee]].<ref name="Episode 1" />

Amee was surprised to learn that Anakin went on not only to win the Boonta race, but also to leave Tatooine shortly afterward. After Anakin's departure, Amee remained friends with Anakin's mother [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]]. She told the older woman that she planned to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] Anakin and leave Tatooine with him. Shmi noted that as she grew older, Amee would swoon at the sight of every handsome young man she met. She later attended the wedding of Shmi and [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For the first movie, I made my own costume, I sewed it and everything. I designed it which was really cool because I've always kind of wanted to be a costume designer.|Katie Lucas on the costume she wore while she portrayed Amee|<ref name="Family">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref>}} The character was portrayed by [[Katie Lucas]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], though Lucas is credited as "Jenna Green".<ref name="Episode 1" />
